30-trading-day average daily volume, absolute share count.
Real-time shares outstanding, absolute share count.
Free-float shares as a percent of shares outstanding.
Bloomberg-computed equity beta, Bloomberg's default calculation window.
Short interest ratio (days-to-cover).
Short interest as a percent of free float.
Last traded/closing price, in the security's trading currency.
Total revenue/turnover, millions of the reporting currency.

Book value per share.
Weighted-average diluted shares used for EPS, millions of shares.
